pages.text: Load both block and entity wagons. Hold an allowed single-block item and use an empty cargo slot. Cargo is scaled down, remains solid and faces relative to your placement position.$(br2)Standard boxes have 2 × 5 slots (10); extended boxes 2 × 6 (12); wide boxes 4 × 8 (32).

Sneak-use cargo to unload it into your inventory; overflow drops into the world. Ordinary cargo uses allowed single-block items. Mats and stools use dedicated accessories.$(br2)Open the tailgate or curtains, or roll back a cover, to access cargo from an unobstructed direction.

Use the rear tailgate to open or close it in either wagon form. It folds outward and hangs down for boarding and loading.$(br2)With a canopy fitted, also open its rear curtains. With a cover, use cargo through the clear rear opening.
